name: cdp5-gates
description: Deterministic read-only T1 skills per CDP5 §32.9 (skill determinism gate): decidable, repeated detectors as Node programs instead of LLM agents. Ships the concept maturity policy (gate plus weighted score) that konzept-lint and konzept-reviewer share, and skill-lint, which checks skills and agents against the Agent Skills specification, the repository conventions and supply-chain signals before a plugin is installed. Every skill returns a reproducible report; the main agent acts on it.
